thesis: Narrow, mechanical BaFin disclosure-review question, not an antitrust question. Statutory clock (4-week submission + 10-15 working-day review) straddles the Sept-1 cutoff; no confirmed approval as of day 42 of 47 pushes this to roughly a coin flip, slightly below CP/gold consensus given deal complexity.

EO 14409's framework exists and was reviewed with OpenAI+Anthropic present Aug 3-4, but the White House explicitly said it won't publicly release it, and 17 of 24 window-days have passed with no qualifying announcement.
